item.title: Refactor order status strings into OrderStatus
item.brief: Refactor the orders crate to use a typed order status. Add src/status.rs with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returning exactly `pending`, `paid`, `shipped`, `cancelled`; Display prints those same lowercase strings. Implement FromStr with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type implementing std::error::Error whose message names the rejected input. Implement `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` allowing only pending→paid, pending→cancelled, paid→shipped, paid→cancelled. Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError at the crate root, and use the enum everywhere so status string literals occur only in src/status.rs. Preserve observable behavior exactly, including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing. Run `cargo test` and ensure it passes. Commit the work on the item branch; do not push or merge.
